author: DJI
description:
Introducing DJI SDR Transmission 2, the Multi-Group Wireless Video Transceiver — Go Small, Connect All.

DJI SDR Transmission 2 advances SDR technology with stronger interference resistance, better image quality, and greater range. Even on crowded sets, it maintains a high-bitrate, low-latency feed. A TX/RX switchable transceiver design and Ronin series compatibility bring pro-grade performance to a compact, lightweight form factor.

Key features of the DJI SDR 2:
✅1 TX to 8 RX With Control, Multi-Group Transmission 
✅Auto Channel 2.0 for Seamless, Stable Feed
✅TX/RX Switchable for Flexible Deployment
✅Pairing-Free Connection for Fast Camera Switching
✅Supports Ronin Monitoring & Control
✅DCI 4K/60fps 10-bit HDR Wireless Transmission

👉 Learn more: https://brnw.ch/21x5KqX

#DJI #DJISDR #SDR2 #WirelessTransmission
title: Introducing DJI SDR Transmission 2 |  Go Small, Connect All
